description: Client-side script for dynamically adding and managing layout routes and modules in an OpenCart admin interface, including functions to add routes and modules, and update module links based on selection.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Dynamically creates and appends a new route row in the layout configuration table.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Dynamically creates and appends a new module row in the layout configuration table, and updates sort order and triggers change events.
